principles: Layered foreground/middle/distant planes with atmospheric falloff.
One dominant focal read, with a few controlled warm highlights rather than uniform gold/HDR.
Scale from familiar small figures/props, contact with ground and consistent perspective.
Material wear specific to object and setting, not indiscriminate noise.
Selective focus/contrast: subject and decisive interaction readable; background can recede.
Camera inside the scene through foreground framing/shoulder views, not repeated posed portraits.
